name: Waveform
description: A waveform drawn as a bar per sample, its height taken from the cell index.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; bottom: 6%; width: 60%; height: @calc(16 + 76 * @abs(@sin(@i * 1.1)))%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
